first_public_note: arXiv 2106.09171v1, 16 June 2021; Interspeech 2021 proceedings (DOI 10.21437/Interspeech.2021-1360) is the same text. Prior = first public before 2020-12; [concurrent] = 2020-12 to 2021-12; [later] = after 2021-12.
prep: no prep/ folder; plan, audits and comparators built by the writer; published topic tables reused append-only

inherited.M01: voiced LRS3 / LRW / LRS2 talking-face video
inherited.M05: dlib-landmark mouth ROI 96x96, 88x88 crop, 25 fps (authors' lineage [15])
inherited.M06: 3D conv + ResNet-18 + Conformer; MS-TCN classifier (LRW) or hybrid CTC/attention (LRS2), following [16]
inherited.M07: Transformer LM on LRS2+LRS3+LibriSpeech text in decoding, beam 20 ([16] lineage)
inherited.M11: public LRW and LRS2 test sets; unlabelled LRS3 for pre-training

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept: lip-reading and video-to-speech studies with video-only input at test that use paired audio or a speech model in training to enrich the visual model (distillation, audio-feature regression, audio memory); audio-visual models needing audio at test excluded. For this review the population is screened to decoders first public before 2020-12 (prior) and 2020-12 to 2021-12 ([concurrent]); video-to-speech systems whose audio is the output, self-distillation without audio, AVSR without transfer and off-task papers are removed.
topics.fulltext_pattern: lip-reading / VSR / video-to-speech context followed by prediction, regression or reconstruction of mel spectrograms, acoustic or audio features/representations, PASE, wav2vec or HuBERT features (whole wiki)
topics.metric: LRW top-1 accuracy (no word boundary, visual only); LRS2 VSR WER

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept: self-supervised or teacher-generated pre-training on unlabelled non-audio-only input before supervised fine-tuning for speech or text decoding. For this review screened to visual-speech decoders evaluated on lip reading, prior = before 2020-12, [concurrent] = 2020-12 to 2021-12; separation, synchronisation-only, tongue-image, cued-speech hand-shape and VAD papers removed.
topics.design_field: supervision_kind; objective classified by title and full text (contrastive or synchronisation, teacher distillation, audio-feature regression)
topics.metric: LRS2 VSR WER after self-supervised pre-training and LRS2 fine-tuning

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept (visual-only LRW top-1 accuracy). For the run-spread count: LRW word-level systems first public before 2020-12 with full text; datasets, keyword spotting, enhancement, separation, talking-face generation, adversarial-attack detection, lip-to-speech and surveys removed.
topics.design_regex: spread = standard deviation | std | ± digit | confidence interval | random seeds | N independent/repeated runs | averaged over N runs/seeds (hits inspected: augmentation ranges and timing averages are not run spread)
topics.metric: LRW top-1 accuracy, visual only, no word-boundary input; repetition
